observed_behavior: An idle worker from one campaign became a reuse candidate in another campaign, and foreign sessions exhausted the latter's creation capacity.
expected_behavior: Only sessions with successful creation recorded in the selected campaign may be reused or counted against its session limit.
causal_mechanism: Dispatch preparation copied worker rows from sibling ledgers, while capacity summed all project ledgers without checking creation provenance.

anti_pattern.structural_description: A shared-project ledger inventory was treated as a transferable worker ownership registry.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: Physical project co-location does not prove campaign origin, and copied rows persist beyond the decision that imported them.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Campaign creation history proves session ownership; another campaign's history never supplies reuse or capacity members.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Use successful CREATE_WORKER results as the existing durable registry, filter idle reuse by session origin, and count only current-campaign sessions and creation reservations.

applicability_conditions: More than one campaign ledger exists for one top-level project
At least one ledger retains a worker or creation reservation
known_non_matches: A new worker created by the selected campaign and recorded in its completed creation history
A bootstrap whose creation remains pending and consumes a current-campaign reservation
confirmation_evidence: Before the correction, a successor campaign selected another campaign's idle session.
Fifteen foreign workers prevented a new current-campaign creation; the focused test failed before repair and passed after.
regression_proofs: tests/campaign-orchestration.test.js: advance retains every completed pair even without ready dispatch
tests/campaign-orchestration.test.js: foreign campaign sessions do not consume the current campaign capacity
tests/campaign-orchestration.test.js: a historical imported worker without current-campaign creation cannot be reused or counted
tests/campaign-orchestration.test.js: one working campaign session leaves independent ready plans dispatchable
tests/worker-worktrees.test.js: fifteen creation reservations bound one campaign, not another campaign or top-level project
